notes: Five independent serialize/aggregate deliverables must ALL hold simultaneously (grouped CSV summaries with a totals row, ordered CSV result sets, status tallies with exactly-once label lines, TOML with an exact two-integer schema, and byte-identical fixed-width records). The verifier independently recomputes every artifact on visible fixtures AND four hidden scenarios (header-only inputs, unsorted frame params, zero-match tallies, whitespace-padded statuses, negative counts, boundary-width records), so a single off-by-one, stray space, missed trim, or misused alignment fails. Difficulty reaches the hard bucket (18) via reasoning_depth 3 (byte-exact widths/alignment/padding plus sort-key chains and range normalization), debugging_ambiguity 3 (failures surface only as byte-level diffs with no locator), adversarial_inputs 3 (empty/edge/malformed variants), and quantitative_correctness 3 (every sum, count, and label must match exactly).
